extracted.intended_audience: general readers and students of 19th-century English literature (readers of Thackeray, satire, and comic narrative)
extracted.subtask_description: Close reading of a chapter from a Victorian comic/romantic narrative (Thackeray), focusing on plot, character interaction, irony, and comedic effect rather than prescriptive guidelines. The text is a narrative excerpt, not a how-to or evaluation rubric.
